description: Everything that waits on a provider or on later work. A provider item is a working sandbox stand-in behind an interface; its service stays OFF for real users until the item is contract_signed (or live) for that country. `later` items are non-provider work that must happen before certain things go live. python3 providers/check.py keeps this honest: no stale entries, no unregistered placeholders, no service switched on without its provider.

later.name: Official payment artwork (Visa, Mastercard, mobile money and other providers)
later.why_not_now: These logos belong to other companies. LynkOmni may show them only as supplied by each company, usually once the provider or acquirer contract is signed. Until then every method shows a LynkOmni method icon with the provider's name as text (ts/src/payments.ts).
later.done_when: For each signed provider, its official artwork and usage rules are stored in a checksum-locked folder with the brand module, paymentOptions marks that method official, and the icon plus name is replaced only for that method and only in countries where that provider is signed.

later.name: Machine translation engine for every LynkOmni language (Google MADLAD-400-3B-MT, Apache 2.0)
later.why_not_now: Done 2026-11-07. The owner replaced Meta NLLB-200 (CC-BY-NC licence, no commercial use) with Google MADLAD-400-3B-MT (Apache 2.0). tools/translation/install_engine.py checks the licence, pins the model revision and converts it to CTranslate2 int8; the GitHub Actions workflow "translation" installs it (cached) and runs tools/translation/check_engine.py in every language. Because the 3B model was weak on short screen labels, screen text is translated by Claude (tools/translation/claude_packs.py, owner decision 2026-11-07); the engine is for text people type.
later.done_when: The engine is installed with a checked licence and pinned revision, knows every language in design/fonts/scripts.v1.json, every emulator has a current, fully translated pack for every language, and tests/test_layout_i18n.py passes in every language.

later.name: Translation engine running on LynkOmni's own server for text people type (chat messages, product names, notes)
later.why_not_now: LynkOmni has no production server yet (infra/ is a plan). Screen text is already translated ahead of time into the language packs. Until the server exists, ContentTranslator has no engine, so typed text is shown in the original with the state "queued"; tests use SandboxTranslator.
later.done_when: The API server image installs ctranslate2 and sentencepiece and mounts the engine folder made by tools/translation/install_engine.py as LYNK_MT_DIR; ContentTranslator uses MadladTranslator there; typed text never leaves LynkOmni's servers.

user_actions.what: Approve workflow runs on pull requests opened by the brand-sync bot (button 'Approve workflows to run' on the pull request).
user_actions.why: GitHub does not run checks on bot pull requests until a person approves.

user_actions.what: Allow package installs in Claude's network settings, then start a new chat.
user_actions.why: Needed for font files and any library the interface emulators or tests may need later; until then everything is built without extra libraries. It also lets Claude install the NLLB-200 translation engine.
user_actions.done_note: Owner allowed package installs and Hugging Face for Claude Code cloud environments on 2026-11-06. The claude.ai chat workspace still blocks Hugging Face, so the translation engine is installed on GitHub Actions (workflow "translation") instead.

user_actions.what: Sign each provider in the ledger (card issuer, mobile money, banks, tax office, SMS, cloud) per country and send Claude the sandbox keys and documents.
user_actions.why: A service switches on for real users only when its provider is signed.

user_actions.what: Have a human designer review all visuals, icons and interface emulators.
user_actions.why: Everything is a draft until a designer signs off.

user_actions.what: Arrange a human security review of anything that moves money, sealing and card screens.
user_actions.why: Required before release by the LynkOmni rules.
user_actions.when: before any money feature goes live

user_actions.what: Arrange a human accessibility audit (WCAG 2.2 AA).
user_actions.why: Automatic checks are not a full audit.

user_actions.what: Have a lawyer check LynkOmni and product names, and register domains.
Create Apple Developer and Google Play developer accounts for the organisation.
user_actions.why: Needed to publish the real Android and iOS apps and capture store screenshots.

user_actions.what: Choose a supplier of Android handheld POS terminals with a built-in printer (and a counter tablet setup), and get two sample devices.
user_actions.why: The LynkPOS emulator shows an original LynkOmni design; the real app must be tested on the real terminals merchants will buy, and the supplier must allow our logo on the casing.

user_actions.what: Ask native speakers to check the words and screens in each language we launch with (Arabic, Persian, Urdu, Hebrew, Hindi, Swahili, Kinyarwanda, French, Spanish and others in design/fonts/scripts.v1.json).
user_actions.why: Fonts and right-to-left layout are in place, but translations written by Claude must be checked by people who speak the language before real users see them.
user_actions.when: before launching in a country that uses the language
user_actions.done_note: Owner decision 2026-11-06: no native-speaker review; machine translation (Google MADLAD-400; Meta NLLB-200 was replaced for licence reasons) with automatic protection and layout checks instead.

user_actions.what: Create the official LynkOmni accounts and claim the name on LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, WhatsApp Business, Snapchat, Pinterest and Threads; send Claude the links of the seven footer channels.
user_actions.why: Claiming the name everywhere stops others from impersonating LynkOmni; the footer links must lead to real, active accounts.
user_actions.done_note: Claimed as "LynkOmni" on all ten platforms on 2026-11-06; footer links connected (ts/src/footer.ts SOCIAL_LINKS); LinkedIn is a showcase page under the CruxOmni Group company page.
